$description: Component tokens: only values a project may need to tune per component.

row-height.$description: A body row's height in the table layout, from 768 px up (44px).

height.$description: The list row's minimum height; a row with a description grows past it.
A pill's height; on a touch screen it keeps a 40px hit area.

width.$description: A dialog's width; on a phone it is the screen's width less a margin, or the screen's as a bottom sheet.

side-width.$description: The width of a sheet on the start or end side, at most the screen's width less a gap.

peek-height.$description: How much of a drawer shows at its peek snap point on a phone: the handle, the header and the top of the body.

item-height.$description: An item's height (40px), its touch target too.
